inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.constructor.directory
inputs.description: Filesystem directory used as the base for projection and lookup cache files. The constructor stores it without validating or creating it; writes create it recursively when needed.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.get.identity
inputs.description: Identifies the principal, project, repository, source revision, optional notes and evidence revisions, artifact hash, and profile bound to cached bytes. Its sorted enumerable fields form the cache key, and a cache hit does not authorize a read.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.get.expectedHash
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 digest of the cached bytes, written as lowercase hexadecimal. The lookup resolves to null unless the stored hash and a fresh digest of the bytes both match it.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.put.identity
inputs.description: Identifies the principal, project, repository, source revision, optional notes and evidence revisions, artifact hash, and profile bound to cached bytes. Its sorted enumerable fields form the cache key, and a cache hit does not authorize a read.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.put.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to cache under the supplied identity. The service persists them as base64 and accepts them only when their SHA-256 digest matches expectedHash.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.put.expectedHash
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 digest of bytes, written as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The service rejects the write unless this digest matches the bytes.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.remember.scope
inputs.description: String scope used to select a lookup record and bind the remembered value to the identity profile. The service hashes the scope for its filename and does not validate a scope format.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.remember.identity
inputs.description: Identity whose context is bound to the remembered value. The service combines its profile with scope and replaces artifactHash with the serialized value's digest.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.remember.value
inputs.description: Value JSON-serialized into the scoped cache and parsed back by lookup. It must serialize to a defined JSON string, and JSON serialization may not preserve every JavaScript value's original type.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.lookup.scope
inputs.description: String scope used to select the lookup record created by remember. A missing, malformed, identity-mismatched, or integrity-failing record resolves to null.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.discard.scope
inputs.description: String scope selecting the lookup record and associated projection entry to discard. The helper hashes the scope to locate the lookup filename and ignores read or unlink failures.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.purge.principalId
inputs.description: Principal identifier used to select cache entries for removal. Only entries whose identity has this principalId are selected.

inputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.purge.projectId
inputs.description: Optional project identifier used to narrow the purge. Omitting it removes entries for the principal across projects; supplying it also removes that project's entries and entries marked for $projects.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.get
outputs.description: Resolves to cached bytes only when the stored identity and hash match and the bytes recompute to expectedHash; otherwise it resolves to null. Returned bytes do not grant access without caller-side authority revalidation.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.put
outputs.description: Resolves after writing the bytes and identity/hash metadata while the cache generation remains unchanged. Hash mismatches, filesystem failures, or a concurrent generation change reject the promise.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.remember
outputs.description: Resolves to the ISO timestamp recorded as cachedAt after the value and lookup metadata are written. The service does not apply an expiration policy to this timestamp.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.lookup
outputs.type: Promise<{ value: unknown; identity: CacheIdentity; cachedAt: string; } | null>
outputs.description: Resolves to null unless the scoped record has a valid timestamp, matching identity binding, and intact cached bytes; otherwise it returns the parsed value, original identity, and cachedAt. Read, parse, and integrity failures are caught and represented as null.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.discard
outputs.description: Resolves after attempting to remove the lookup record for scope and its associated projection entry. The helper ignores read and unlink failures.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.purge
outputs.description: Resolves after scanning cache files and removing entries for principalId, restricted to projectId when supplied while also removing $projects entries. It increments the generation first so earlier in-flight writes are rejected and cleaned up.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.clear
outputs.description: Resolves after incrementing the cache generation and deleting files matching the projection and lookup filename patterns. A missing directory is treated as empty; other enumeration or unlink failures reject.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem Error can reject writes or removals; put also throws Error when expectedHash is invalid or mismatched, or when the cache generation changes during a write.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: remember can reject with TypeError when JSON serialization or Buffer conversion cannot produce defined bytes, such as for a BigInt, cyclic value, or top-level undefined value.

outputs.name: ProjectionCacheService.constructor
outputs.description: Constructs a ProjectionCacheService instance with the supplied cache directory and initializes its generation counter to zero.
